description: This file manages legacy crypto state detection, inspection, and migration for Matrix accounts within the openclaw project. It includes functions for loading crypto inspectors, detecting legacy crypto stores, resolving account plans, and preparing migration states, with detailed handling of backup keys and migration warnings.

methods.name: isMatrixLegacyCryptoInspectorAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the Matrix legacy crypto inspector is available (always returns true).

methods.name: loadMatrixLegacyCryptoInspector
methods.description: Dynamically imports and loads the legacy crypto inspector module.

methods.name: detectLegacyBotSdkCryptoStore
methods.description: Detects if a legacy Matrix crypto store exists at a given directory, returning detection status and warnings.

methods.name: resolveMatrixAccountIds
methods.description: Resolves configured Matrix account IDs from the project configuration.

methods.name: resolveLegacyMatrixFlatStorePlan
methods.description: Resolves the plan for migrating a legacy Matrix flat store, returning plan details or warnings.

methods.name: loadLegacyBotSdkMetadata
methods.description: Loads metadata (device ID) from a legacy bot SDK crypto store directory.

methods.name: resolveMatrixLegacyCryptoPlans
methods.description: Resolves all potential crypto migration plans and warnings for configured Matrix accounts.

methods.name: loadStoredRecoveryKey
methods.description: Loads a stored recovery key JSON file if it exists.

methods.name: loadLegacyCryptoMigrationState
methods.description: Loads the migration state JSON file if it exists.

methods.name: persistLegacyMigrationState
methods.description: Persists the migration state JSON atomically to disk.

methods.name: detectLegacyMatrixCrypto
methods.description: Detects legacy Matrix crypto states and returns detection info with warnings if inspector is unavailable.

methods.name: autoPrepareLegacyMatrixCrypto
methods.description: Automatically prepares legacy Matrix crypto states for migration, inspecting stores, importing keys, and recording migration states, with detailed warnings and logs.
